source_title: JetBrains Air — Agentic Development Environment (multi-agent IDE)
verdict: WATCH — validates multi-agent concurrent development paradigm at enterprise scale (JetBrains, 2300+ employees, 26 years); proprietary GUI-first approach is opposite of our headless automation architecture; HN community confirms review bottleneck thesis (Master Blueprint principle #5); ACP protocol worth monitoring but competes with A2A (22K stars)

discovered_urls.title: Air Launches as Public Preview — JetBrains Blog
discovered_urls.notes: Launch blog post with architectural philosophy details. Key quote: 'Complex codebases aren't yet ready for pure agentic coding.' Describes ACP protocol, Docker+worktree sandboxing, BYOK model.

discovered_urls.title: HN Discussion: Agentic Development Environment by JetBrains (74 pts, 64 comments)
discovered_urls.notes: Community reception confirms review bottleneck as primary constraint. cube2222: 'my reviewing throughput is usually saturated by a single agent already.' Validates our Master Blueprint principle #5 and #4 (coordination overhead exponent 1.724). faizshah: long-time JetBrains user disappointed, wants deep debugger/diff integration not just parallel agent UI.

discovered_urls.notes: Fleet abandonment context. Low engagement but confirms Fleet->Air strategic pivot.
